name: Mainstream Green Solutions LLC
description: Since 2009, Mainstream Green has been veteran owned and operated, providing our customers with quality, reliable systems designed to last.  Our founding team all obtained Sharp Solar Certification in 2009, and Ernie obtained NABCEP PV Installation Professional Certification in 2012.  We've been learning and growing ever since.  We attained Sol-Ark "Gold" Installer status in 2023.  Sol-Ark offers the best solution we've found in 15+ years for the average person to be able to achieve some level of "Personal energy independence" using solar power.  A growing number of our Sol-Ark installs are 100% off-grid.   Our team has worked with families, farmers, and businesses across West Tennessee to reduce their electricity costs and become more energy independent.  We've also provided some of these clients with an optional whole-home backup power system, where everything stays on when the power goes off. If you have an older system under TVA's expired 10 year premium programs, we can convert it to a home back-up energy reducing system.   If we install it, we will service it.
